notes: A comedy post: almost every card carries a joke nickname in parentheses; each row keeps the posted text and links the card named before the parentheses.
Starting cards as posted under 'Start': Local Uprising / Liberation, Cloud City: Casino and Don't Tread On Me; they count toward the total.
The list as posted totals 61 cards; kept as published.

The title says 'Puerto Rico States Winner' and the post says it won the Puerto Rican state championship 6-0 with a differential of +340 because everyone conceded, and asks readers to 'rate the deck accordingly for comedy sake'; treated as a joke, so the deck is filed as a general DeckTech list.
The strategy update says he added Jurri Juice, Blue Milk and Tight Squeeze, and a Hypo for Col Cracken; these are not in the posted list and are not added.
'With Hydraulic lift and button tuck crush velvet interior' (under the swoop) is a comment, not a card.
Posted 'Rebel Scanners' matches no card; printed as written (UNKNOWN). Best guess: Rebel Planners (Premiere Light Effect).
Posted 'Luke Skywalker (semi Jedi Knight)' dested the Premiere Luke Skywalker, following the post's 'card (joke nickname)' pattern, not Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight.

Posted 'Jedi Test #5' dested It Is The Future You See (Dagobah Jedi Test #5); 'Col Cracken' dested Colonel Cracken; 'Mirax' dested Mirax Terrik; 'Anakins Saber' dested Anakin's Lightsaber; 'Princess Leia' dested the Cloud City Princess Leia; 'Lando Calrissian' dested the Light Cloud City Lando Calrissian; 'Im With You 2' dested I'm With You Too; 'Lets Keep a Little Optimism Here' dested the Death Star II printing; 'Admirals Order No Questions Asked' dested the Admiral's Order No Questions Asked.
Gambler's Luck (posted under Effects) is an Interrupt; Never Tell Me The Odds (posted under 'Interrupts and Misc.') is an Effect.
Threepio With His Parts Showing and You'll Find I'm Full Of Surprises are Tatooine-set cards (Tatooine released 30 May 2001), though the post is dated 20 April 2001.
